raw_market.question: Maryland vs. Ohio State: 1Q O/U 7.5
raw_market.description:
In the first quarter of the college football game between Maryland and Ohio State, scheduled for October 10 at 4:15 PM ET:

This market will resolve to "Over" if Maryland and Ohio State combine to score 8 or more points in the first quarter.

If the combined first quarter total is less than 8, this market will resolve to "Under".

Only points scored during that period count; overtime is not included.

If the game is postponed, this market will remain open until the game has been completed. If the game is canceled entirely, with no make-up game, this market will resolve 50-50.
